verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for an online legal-services platform like LegalZoom, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no public API at all; it covers only UI-driven services, a dashboard and specialist consults. The llms.txt probe is crawler guidance, not a programmatic interface, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
